top_signals.title: Dollar Enjoys Best Month Since June on Fed’s Inflation Fight
top_signals.summary: The dollar is wrapping up its best month since June after the Federal Reserve’s renewed focus on taming inflation pushed interest-rate expectations and US bond yields higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Foreign Investors Pull $3.2 Billion From Indian Markets as Oil Rally Returns
top_signals.summary: The renewed rally in oil prices above $100 per barrel Brent has prompted foreign investors to pull money out of India’s stock and bond markets at the highest pace since March, when the start of the Iran war and the oil supply crunch in Asia launched a massive exodus from Asian assets. Following the largest outflows this year in March, India’s assets returned to booking inflows in April, May, June, and July, with a record of inflows in June, according to data from Clearing Corporation of India Limited compiled by Bloomberg. top_signals.title: Suntory’s collaborative approach to water stewardship
top_signals.summary: The region comprising the city of Kumamoto and 10 surrounding municipalities is a rare example of an area where the tap water for approximately 1 million residents is sourced almost entirely from groundwater. Volcanic deposits from ancient eruptions of Mount Aso created a highly porous soil structure that naturally filters rainwater deep underground, enriching it with minerals.

top_signals.title: Monte Paschi CEO Says Shareholders Will See Value in Twin Offers
top_signals.summary: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena Chief Executive Officer Luigi Lovaglio tells Bloomberg Television he is confident shareholders will recognize the value of his twin takeover offers for Banco BPM and Banca Generali. "We are building an Italian champion," Lovaglio says. The CEO needs support from at least two thirds of the votes cast at a shareholder meeting on Oct. 29 to proceed with his plan. Lovaglio speaks to Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua. (Source: Bloomberg)
